checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even 'around $X' or 'about half price' counts.

bot claims a bookable program that is NOT one of: Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Adult No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Adult Muay Thai (Kickboxing), Adult Wrestling, Kettle Bell Workout, Youth Martial Arts, Teen Martial Arts. Flag source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. Vacaville, Bodega, Gracie).
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.
bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' where it should give a firm known answer (e.g. MMA not bookable online, under-5 not bookable).
bot proactively names/pushes a specific adult discipline (No-Gi, Muay Thai, Wrestling, Kettlebell) before the lead states a preference. It may ask which discipline; it must not steer.
bot output contains unreplaced tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks who it is for (self / child / both) before collecting names, DOBs, contact details.
bot asks date of birth (not just age) for each enrollee before the booking tool fires.

when the adult names a discipline, the booking is for that calendar: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu->Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu; No-Gi->Adult No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu; Muay Thai/kickboxing->Adult Muay Thai (Kickboxing); wrestling->Adult Wrestling; kettlebell/conditioning->Kettle Bell Workout. No discipline stated -> Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (default). Wrong-calendar booking is a fail.
ages 5-12 -> Youth Martial Arts; ages 13-17 -> Teen Martial Arts. Cross-band routing is a mis-route. Under age 5 -> NO booking, refer to gym (732) 795-5626.
if lead pushes pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to the free trial / staff. Never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: lead under 18 with no parent/guardian involved: bot must NOT book. Capture name + DOB + parent contact, close with team-will-follow-up framing.

MMA, Personal Training / private sessions, Open Mat: bot acknowledges they exist but does NOT book them and does not invent a calendar; defers to the free trial / coach. No substitute-calendar routing.
